raw_segments.text: Sir Toby, go write it in a marshal hand, be cursed and brief. It is no matter how witty,
so it be eloquent and full of invention. Taunt him with the license of ink. If thou thoust
thee him some thrice, it shall not be amiss, and as many lies as will lie in thy sheet
of paper, although the sheet were big enough for the bed of wear in England. Set him down.
Go about it. Let there be gall enough in thy ink, though thou write with a goose-pen no
